rig.layers: body = toad + parasol in depth order (draw it alone); flash = the same frame with the toad as a cream silhouette and the parasol untouched (swap it in for ~60 ms on a body hit; HIT FLASH sold: skip); shadow = a flat mask in its own frame (shadow_frame, anchored at shadow_anchor on the feet): shade the ground one step darker (core.SHADE), drawn under everything; shadow_mirror = the shadow for the mirrored (left-facing) frame: draw it UNFLIPPED, because the sun still casts to the lower right; eyes = the eye pixels only (finale: draw just these above the dead pixels).
rig.directions: side = parasol facing right (0 deg); front34 = 45 (down-right); front = 90 (down); back34 = -45 (up-right); back = -90 (up). Angles are screen degrees, 0 = +x, clockwise (+y down). Mirror side/front34/back34 for 180/135/-135: flip on the anchor x, parasol_facing -> 180 - parasol_facing, canopy.x -> -canopy.x, cw <-> ccw.
rig.facing: The sprite's facing is the parasol's angle, which turns toward Wick at <= 100 deg/s. Pick the nearest of the 8 facings; while the angle is more than 5.6 deg from it, show the turn frame whose parasol_facing is nearest (frames every 11.25 deg). Movement direction never changes the sprite (it shuffles sideways when circled).
rig.frame_data: ms; parasol_facing (deg, the drawn parasol); canopy = centre of the canopy, anchor-relative (+x right, +y down): where splashes sit when a shot is blocked head-on; hop: lift; death: body_gone.
rig.y_sort: sort by the feet anchor y
rig.hit_stop: freeze the toad 50 ms on hurt frame 0 (the flash) and 40 ms on block frame 0

behaviour.block: every shot arriving from within +-55 deg of the parasol facing is blocked, pierce included: the shot stops on the canopy, splash_any_fx plays there (row = the direction back toward the shooter), block/block_cw/block_ccw by where it struck (|offset| < 18 deg: block), no damage. Shots from the sides and back hit: hurt + the light's impact.
behaviour.formation: later in a line of 3 (about 34 px apart), shoulder to shoulder
behaviour.sizes: toad ~26 x 22 px, parasol ~27 px across; hit_radius 9 around body_centre

tells.parasol_facing: every animation: the light outer canopy (sky, ice lace, ferrule spike) points where it blocks; from behind you see the dark underside (deep, blue ribs) and the toad's warty back: that is the side to shoot
tells.canopy_vs_body: a blocked shot = block_* (canopy dents, no flash) + cool drops; a hit = hurt (cream toad flash, croak) + the warm impact

splash_any_fx.rows: 16 directions: row d sprays toward angle d*22.5 deg (0 = +x, clockwise); use the direction from the hit point back toward the shooter
splash_any_fx.anchor: the hit point on the canopy
splash_any_fx.note: cool drops only (ice, sky, blue): the canopy never shows Wick's warm light

idle.note: 12 frames x 2 ticks (2 s): throat pulse, back breathes, the canopy sways a beat behind, one blink. Frame 0 is the still pose (ANIMATIONS sold).

hop.note: the gait, 12 frames x 1 tick (1 s per hop): crouch, deep crouch, launch, air, land (big splat), wobble, settle. Move the sprite only on frames 3-7 (about 16 px per hop); the parasol lags a frame and wobbles on the landing.

turn.note: in-betweens from facing a to facing b, 11.25 deg apart (112.5 ms each = 100 deg/s). Play forward to turn a->b, backward to turn b->a; mirror for the left half. Or pick the frame whose parasol_facing is nearest the toad's current parasol angle.

block.note: a shot struck the canopy near its centre: dent, shove back, shudder, settle. No flash, no damage. Play splash_any_fx at the hit point.

block_cw.note: the shot struck the canopy's clockwise side (from facing + 18..55 deg); mirrored sprites swap cw and ccw

block_ccw.note: the shot struck the canopy's counter-clockwise side (from facing - 18..55 deg)

hurt.note: a shot in the side or back: frame 0 is already flashed (cream toad, the parasol never flashes), then a flinch, a croak (the throat balloons), a grumble.

death.note: one-shot, ~1.3 s, tall frames: the toad flops belly-up and dissolves in the light's colours (weapons.json deaths.dissolve, already baked in: do not apply it again; play the light's death_large overlay at body_centre when frame 7 starts, as mechanic.gif does); the parasol, let go, turns upright, bobs once over the toad and floats off up and to the right, spinning slowly. Remove the enemy after the last frame.
